assessment: The grouping predicate compares the entire ordered Field records, preserving ID, owner, range and multiplicity as well as within-owner order. It rejects interleaved owner presentation instead of silently rewriting accepted candidates.

The module.nodes array is correctly treated as identity-indexed storage; child slots, roots and call arguments retain their ordered syntax meaning. This does not permit arbitrary reordering of semantic child lists or declaration arrays.

Result-sensitive OrderRequired applies only to accepted and unknown-applied-success. Replay, key collision and authorization denial remain independent of fresh candidate order and parser availability. Concrete unordered-candidate replay/collision witnesses exercise this distinction.
CandidateOrder is vacuous for TEXT_ONLY. The additional presentation constraint does not manufacture an IR, weaken type/schema checking or authorize a canonical pair.
Original transition guarantees are retained by conjunction with Step/AdmittedStep. This is a conservative acceptance restriction, not a change to underlying Alloy or SQL semantics.

formal_assessment.limits: Read-only proof/type inspection. The partial guarded relation proves the success-order restriction and preserves early outcomes; it does not itself construct a deterministic INVALID_DRAFT receipt transition for an otherwise valid unordered candidate. That concrete denial/receipt mapping remains an explicit runtime adapter obligation, consistent with this amendment limited to accepted/unknown-applied-success properties. No full transition completeness or parser/Java/TypeScript refinement claim.

finite_implementation_acceptance: Server and browser reject a complete interleaved fields candidate deterministically; accepted head/source/history unchanged and any admitted deterministic rejection receipt follows existing exact-byte replay rules.
Grouped multiple-owner fields preserve within-owner order through print/elaboration, including field IDs, range columns and multiplicity.
Shuffling flat node registry leaves ordered syntax unchanged; shuffling child slots or call arguments does not get the same exemption.
An unordered candidate supplied with an existing exact receipt still replays without validation; changed wire collides, and unauthorized access denies before receipt disclosure.
UI field insertion/reassignment is an explicit draft transition with visible reorder; no automatic accepted-history rewrite.
required_sequence: Six exact-three-hash approvals and two clean amendment proof builds before implementing this new order guard. Unrelated previously approved implementation may continue; incomplete engine remains unavailable.
approval_scope: Exact amendment gameplan only. No runtime evidence, G2/G3 closure, commercial claim, or alteration of original237 registered claims.
